title: Little Fish: Shall we put a podcast on? What a stupid idea!
content:
Dan, Andy and Anna discuss YOUR facts including pasta, Proust and pencils. Anna shares her secret 'Wheel of Life' game. And we name eight more Friend of the Podcast custodians.

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com for news about live shows, merchandise and more episodes.

Edited by James Harkin
Produced by Leying Lee
Team includes Tara Dorrell, Joe Mayo and Ethan Ruparelia
